limits: Fixed synthetic corpus, largely German ASCII transliteration; no separate umlaut or Fraktur holdout
Eight global variants were explored; no per-image oracle selection
Protected comparison tests the existing text-evidence gate only; external OCR DTOs are never committed to a vault
Apple timing excludes Swift startup; Tesseract timing includes a fresh subprocess/model loading but excludes preprocessing; not chat latency
No complete package/UI/Relay regression or real-document reread was performed
A passing regression is distinct from the failed >52/79 quality gate
